name: Nishi-Ogikubo
tagline: Shinjuku in 17 minutes and Shibuya in 27 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Suginami City, where JR East run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 36 minutes to Otemachi, 17 minutes to Shinjuku, 27 minutes to Shibuya and 46 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 51 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 7.3 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 51 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 44.6 m to 51.9 m, a difference of 7.3 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 2 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 18 clinics and 12 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 越川病院訪問看護ステーション, about 3 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 杉並リハビリテーション病院, about 5 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. JR Chuo Rapid Line run through it. JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) also call here. Both lines are run by JR East, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: JR Chuo Rapid Line runs at 158% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 中野→新宿, which this station is not on. JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) runs at 151%. Its busiest stretch is 錦糸町→両国, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥140,000 to ¥150,000 and 2LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the low side. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Nishi-Ogikubo is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Nishi-Ogikubo in a straight line. It takes 13 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Nishi-Ogikubo. One-room rents run about ¥9,000 lower.

neighbours.lead: Ogikubo is ahead on the number of lines, but Nishi-Ogikubo is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and quiet.
neighbours.note: About 2 km from Nishi-Ogikubo in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi 3 minutes sooner than Nishi-Ogikubo.

goodFor: People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
People who want a park close by
People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: The data does not show a drawback particular to this station
noiseSources: The nearest big road, 五日市街道, is far enough that little traffic noise reaches the station area

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 7 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: The big roads are far enough that traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
